--- gd-head-tags: - >- ``{=html} open-graph: title: >- [BootstrapResult]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | greenwood description: Result of a bootstrap confidence interval computation. twitter-card: title: >- [BootstrapResult]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} | greenwood description: Result of a bootstrap confidence interval computation. title: >- [BootstrapResult]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass} body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 bread-crumbs: false toc-depth: 3 description-meta: Result of a bootstrap confidence interval computation. page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Result of a bootstrap confidence interval computation. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/greenwood/blob/main/greenwood/_bootstrap.py#L37-L139){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-class} ```pythonsignature BootstrapResult( estimate, se, conf_low, conf_high, conf_level, ci_type, n_boot, distribution, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Holds the point estimate, bootstrap standard error, and confidence interval for a Kaplan-Meier summary statistic. The full bootstrap distribution is retained for diagnostics or custom interval construction. ::: ## Attributes {.doc-attributes} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [estimate]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Point estimate from the original (non-resampled) data. [se]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Bootstrap standard error (standard deviation of the bootstrap distribution). [conf_low]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Lower confidence limit. [conf_high]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Upper confidence limit. [conf_level]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Confidence level used for the interval. [ci_type]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Type of confidence interval (`"percentile"`, `"normal"`, or `"bca"`). [n_boot]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of bootstrap replicates. [distribution]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [Array]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The full bootstrap distribution (array of length `n_boot=`). ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Bootstrap a 95% confidence interval for the median survival time on the `lung` dataset: ::: {#b47f4db0 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import greenwood as gw lung = gw.load_dataset("lung", backend="polars") death = gw.Outcome.surv(time="time", event="status") result = gw.bootstrap(death, statistic="median", n_boot=500, seed=0, data=lung) result ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` BootstrapResult (n_boot=500, ci_type='percentile') estimate se 0.95LCL 0.95UCL 310.000 23.330 283.475 363.000 ``` ::: ::: Export as a single-row DataFrame: ::: {#e947b9c9 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} result.to_frame(format="polars") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
